customManagers.description: Keep the app version in lockstep with the torrential image tag

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped PR, merged automatically once CI passes
torrential: Dockerfile tag + digest and config.yaml version in one PR
prBodyNotes: Before merging: add a `## <new version>` section to `torrential/CHANGELOG.md` (the version check fails until you do), and read the torrential release notes for changes to config.yaml, pairing or how it treats requests from a proxy. See RELEASING.md.

packageRules.description: Tailscale, cloudflared and yq: one grouped PR; needs a packaging revision
prBodyNotes: Before merging: bump `version` in `torrential/config.yaml` to the next packaging revision (the version check names it) and add a CHANGELOG entry. See RELEASING.md.
